name: Doba
summary: Dropshipping marketplace that connects online sellers with wholesale suppliers, with one-click listing to Shopify, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and other channels, inventory lists and AI listing tools.
best_for: online sellers on Shopify, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and similar channels who want to dropship from one wholesale catalogue and push listings into several stores, starting from the Basic tier
skip_if: you want to hold your own stock or build a private-label brand; or you need a clear refund promise before you pay, because the help centre and the terms say different things
honest_knock: The subscription only buys access: product costs, shipping, handling and transaction charges come on top of every order. Limited is too small to run a store on (20 inventory places, no monthly downloads), and Doba's refund terms contradict each other, from a 72-hour full refund in the help centre to 'all fees are non-refundable' in the terms.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-22 on doba.com/pricing with the Monthly, Quarterly and Annually toggles; prices in USD) Doba sells four subscription tiers. Billed monthly, Limited is $29.99 a month, Basic $59.99, Standard $149.99 and Enterprise $299.99. Quarterly billing takes 5% off (Limited $28.67, Basic $57.00, Standard $142.67 a month) and annual billing 15% (Limited $25.50, Basic $51.00, Standard $127.50 a month); Enterprise is sold monthly or annually only. Basic has a 7-day trial and Standard a 5-day trial, each for US$0.99. The fees policy says the full fee of the chosen tier is charged automatically when the trial ends, and the terms limit trials to first-time users. The subscription is not the whole bill: the fees policy says product costs, shipping, drop or order handling fees and transaction charges are paid separately at the time of purchase. Paid add-ons such as the AI Store Builder renew on their own cycle. On refunds Doba's own pages disagree: the help centre says a full refund is issued automatically if you cancel within 72 hours of payment, the fees policy excludes trial subscriptions, and the terms say all fees, including subscription fees, are non-refundable.

compare_with.name: Spocket
compare_with.why: Spocket is in our dossiers too and sells the same kind of supplier catalogue: when we read it on 1 October 2026 its Starter plan was $39.99 a month for 25 products. Doba's Limited is cheaper at $29.99 a month but caps the inventory list at 20 products and lists no monthly downloads, so the fair comparison is Doba Basic at $59.99. Compare the supplier range for your niche and the shipping times, not only the plan price.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Doba twice on a retailer account we created. Without a plan the catalogue hides every price, and the free Doba Pilot gave prices and shipping for three yoga mats for 1 credit. In the Basic trial for US$ 0.99 the prices, the processing time filter and the inventory list worked, and AI Pickr took about 8 seconds and 2 credits. The first charge of US$ 59.99 was set for 27 November, a day after the 7 trial days end. Cancelling took four screens with two retention offers, and the US$ 0.99 was not refunded. Account and start: we created a retailer account. In the morning of 19 November 2026, from about 09:45 to 09:59 CET, our AI assistant tested it in our browser with No Plan and the free Doba Pilot (30 credits). In the afternoon we started the Basic trial ourselves, monthly, US$ 0.99 that day (7:39 AM PST, 16:39 CET), and our assistant tested it from about 16:46 to 16:52 CET in its own tabs. The interface was in English. Promotion popups came up on almost every page and were closed. The review is on MSS (mss/doba-review.html). Round 1, no plan: a search for yoga mat gave 144 results with stock and processing time, but every price read Subscribe to See Price, and Add to Inventory List opened Start Your $0.99 Trial Now. Doba Pilot, at 1 credit a message, answered a request for yoga mats with supplier price, shipping and delivery time in about 1 minute 45 seconds with three products from US$ 14.72 to US$ 33.67, stock, UPS and USPS rates and landed costs. Asked to add a mat to the inventory list, Pilot said Doba has no inventory list it can write to; the counter went from 30 to 28 credits. Round 4, Basic trial: the same search now showed prices (US$ 33.67, 29.46, 29.46, 14.72) with stock and 2 Business Day(s). The filter Max. Avg. Processing Time 2 business days gave 11 results for yoga mat. Add to Inventory List now worked: Add to inventory list successfully, and the Inventory List showed Jute Premium Eco Yoga Mat with 7 variants at US$ 33.67 and shipping US$ 13.69. AI Tool Hub had 300 credits; one AI Pickr run on Sports, Exercise took about 8 seconds and 2 credits (298 / 300 left), with mixed relevance (sunglasses among fitness products). The AI Listing Optimizer needs a product listed to a linked store, and the AI Store Builder starts by linking Shopify; neither was run. Stores: 0/2 stores, nothing linked. The Retailer API needs a Standard or Enterprise plan. Plans and billing: On doba.com/pricing, in USD, with Monthly, Quarterly (5% off) and Annually (15% off) tabs; with Quarterly selected the prices per month are: Limited $28.67, Basic $57.00 with a 7-day Trial for US$ 0.99, Standard $142.67 with a 5-day Trial for US$ 0.99, and Enterprise only monthly or annual. In the trial the plan card lists Storefront Integrations 0/2, Inventory List 0/600, Storefront Products Listings Count 0/250, AI Auto Lister 0/30 and AI Tool Hub Credits 0/300. Pricing Plan shows Basic Trial, Monthly, 7 trial days left, Next Billing Date: Nov 27, 2026 12:00:00 AM (PST) and Next Billing Amount: US$ 59.99; Billing Details show the service cycle from Nov 19 to Nov 26, 2026 7:39:04 AM (PST) and US$ 0.99. The first charge falls about a day after the 7 trial days end. Checkout: in round 1 the trial window was seen and closed with nothing filled in; in round 4 we started the trial ourselves and the checkout was not seen by our assistant. Cancelling, done the same day: Pricing Plan, Actions, Cancel Subscription. A retention screen with Let me think about it and a grey Continue Cancellation link; then a dialog with Cancel immediately (preselected) or Cancel at the end of the current billing cycle and Refund: US$ 0; then One Last Thing Before You Go... with an optional concerns field and a Free for 30 days (worth $90) coupon, declined with Still Leave; then Subscription cancelled successfully! No password and no support contact. The US$ 0.99 trial fee is not refunded. Not tested: linking a store, listing to a store, ordering, the wallet and paid add-ons, the AI Listing Optimizer and a store build, Pay Now, Change Payment Method and the invoice link, and product downloads, which are not included in the trial. Clean up: the account, the inventory list item and the used credits stay; the subscription is cancelled. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Without a plan the catalogue hides every supplier price. Pilot said Doba has no inventory list it can write to, while the trial has one. The first charge falls a day after the 7 trial days end. Cancelling takes four screens with two retention offers, and the exit links are grey text.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Doba twice on a retailer account we created. Without a plan the catalogue hides every price, and the free Doba Pilot gave prices and shipping for three yoga mats for 1 credit. In the Basic trial for US$ 0.99 the prices, the processing time filter and the inventory list worked, and AI Pickr took about 8 seconds and 2 credits. The first charge of US$ 59.99 was set for 27 November, a day after the 7 trial days end. Cancelling took four screens with two retention offers, and the US$ 0.99 was not refunded. Account and start: we created a retailer account. In the morning of 19 November 2026, from about 09:45 to 09:59 CET, our AI assistant tested it in our browser with No Plan and the free Doba Pilot (30 credits). In the afternoon we started the Basic trial ourselves, monthly, US$ 0.99 that day (7:39 AM PST, 16:39 CET), and our assistant tested it from about 16:46 to 16:52 CET in its own tabs. The interface was in English. Promotion popups came up on almost every page and were closed. The review is on MSS (mss/doba-review.html). Round 1, no plan: a search for yoga mat gave 144 results with stock and processing time, but every price read Subscribe to See Price, and Add to Inventory List opened Start Your $0.99 Trial Now. Doba Pilot, at 1 credit a message, answered a request for yoga mats with supplier price, shipping and delivery time in about 1 minute 45 seconds with three products from US$ 14.72 to US$ 33.67, stock, UPS and USPS rates and landed costs. Asked to add a mat to the inventory list, Pilot said Doba has no inventory list it can write to; the counter went from 30 to 28 credits. Round 4, Basic trial: the same search now showed prices (US$ 33.67, 29.46, 29.46, 14.72) with stock and 2 Business Day(s). The filter Max. Avg. Processing Time 2 business days gave 11 results for yoga mat. Add to Inventory List now worked: Add to inventory list successfully, and the Inventory List showed Jute Premium Eco Yoga Mat with 7 variants at US$ 33.67 and shipping US$ 13.69. AI Tool Hub had 300 credits; one AI Pickr run on Sports, Exercise took about 8 seconds and 2 credits (298 / 300 left), with mixed relevance (sunglasses among fitness products). The AI Listing Optimizer needs a product listed to a linked store, and the AI Store Builder starts by linking Shopify; neither was run. Stores: 0/2 stores, nothing linked. The Retailer API needs a Standard or Enterprise plan. Plans and billing: On doba.com/pricing, in USD, with Monthly, Quarterly (5% off) and Annually (15% off) tabs; with Quarterly selected the prices per month are: Limited $28.67, Basic $57.00 with a 7-day Trial for US$ 0.99, Standard $142.67 with a 5-day Trial for US$ 0.99, and Enterprise only monthly or annual. In the trial the plan card lists Storefront Integrations 0/2, Inventory List 0/600, Storefront Products Listings Count 0/250, AI Auto Lister 0/30 and AI Tool Hub Credits 0/300. Pricing Plan shows Basic Trial, Monthly, 7 trial days left, Next Billing Date: Nov 27, 2026 12:00:00 AM (PST) and Next Billing Amount: US$ 59.99; Billing Details show the service cycle from Nov 19 to Nov 26, 2026 7:39:04 AM (PST) and US$ 0.99. The first charge falls about a day after the 7 trial days end. Checkout: in round 1 the trial window was seen and closed with nothing filled in; in round 4 we started the trial ourselves and the checkout was not seen by our assistant. Cancelling, done the same day: Pricing Plan, Actions, Cancel Subscription. A retention screen with Let me think about it and a grey Continue Cancellation link; then a dialog with Cancel immediately (preselected) or Cancel at the end of the current billing cycle and Refund: US$ 0; then One Last Thing Before You Go... with an optional concerns field and a Free for 30 days (worth $90) coupon, declined with Still Leave; then Subscription cancelled successfully! No password and no support contact. The US$ 0.99 trial fee is not refunded. Not tested: linking a store, listing to a store, ordering, the wallet and paid add-ons, the AI Listing Optimizer and a store build, Pay Now, Change Payment Method and the invoice link, and product downloads, which are not included in the trial. Clean up: the account, the inventory list item and the used credits stay; the subscription is cancelled. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Without a plan the catalogue hides every supplier price. Pilot said Doba has no inventory list it can write to, while the trial has one. The first charge falls a day after the 7 trial days end. Cancelling takes four screens with two retention offers, and the exit links are grey text.
